empower-field-at-mile-high.desc_short: Empower Field at Mile High: large bowl with a wavy curved upper rim, tall upper decks on both sidelines, a big scoreboard and white horse statue at the south end, green field

mercedes-benz-stadium.desc_short: Mercedes-Benz Stadium: angular stadium with a pinwheel roof of eight triangular panels around an oculus, sloped silver and glass facade, huge ring video board, field below

paycor-stadium.desc_short: Paycor Stadium: riverfront football bowl with two tall sideline decks under cantilevered canopies, open ends, glass and metal facade, green field

highmark-stadium.desc_short: Highmark Stadium: new compact football stadium with a deep steep bowl, a large canopy roof over most seats, limestone and glass exterior, green field

great-american-ball-park.desc_short: Great American Ball Park: riverfront ballpark with a gap in the stands behind third base, two smokestacks on the center field batter's eye, white steel and brick, grass field

american-family-field.desc_short: American Family Field: ballpark with a fan-shaped retractable roof of curved steel panels pivoting over the field, brick base, grass field

daikin-park.desc_short: Daikin Park: downtown ballpark with a large retractable roof and glass wall in left field, a historic railroad station facade as the main entrance, grass field

truist-park.desc_short: Truist Park: suburban ballpark with a white steel canopy roof over the upper deck, brick and stone base, asymmetric outfield, grass field

globe-life-field.desc_short: Globe Life Field: very large climate-controlled ballpark under a vast arched retractable roof, brick and stone exterior, artificial grass field

loandepot-park.desc_short: loanDepot park: modern white ballpark with a retractable roof of three large panels sliding on tracks, glass wall in left field facing downtown, grass field

kyle-field.desc_short: Kyle Field: very large closed college football bowl with tall steep upper decks on all sides, brick and gray concrete exterior with towers, green field

darrell-k-royal-texas-memorial-stadium.desc_short: Darrell K Royal Texas Memorial Stadium: huge college football bowl, tall upper decks on both sidelines and a closed south end zone, large video board at the north end, green field

bryant-denny-stadium.desc_short: Bryant-Denny Stadium: huge college football bowl with tall upper decks on all four sides, brick and column exterior, green field

memorial-stadium-sc.desc_short: Memorial Stadium Clemson: college football horseshoe bowl with a grass hill at the open east end, tall west side deck with press box, green field

razorback-stadium.desc_short: Razorback Stadium: college football horseshoe bowl with tall decks on both sidelines and a closed north end zone, brick exterior, green field

td-garden.desc_short: TD Garden: box-shaped arena built above a rail station, glass and metal facade, flat roof, a tall office tower beside it

allen-fieldhouse.desc_short: Allen Fieldhouse: historic rectangular field house of tan limestone with a long arched barrel roof and tall arched windows

charlotte-motor-speedway.desc_short: Charlotte Motor Speedway: banked quad-oval of gray asphalt around a green infield with a lake, a long multi-level grandstand with suites along the front stretch, pit road, no cars, no crowd

nissan-stadium.desc_short: Nissan Stadium: riverfront football bowl with navy blue seats and red bands between tiers, tall sideline decks, steel light towers on both sideline rims, green field

lincoln-financial-field.desc_short: Lincoln Financial Field: football stadium with dark midnight green seats, curved wing-shaped canopy roofs over both sideline stands, open ends, dark steel and glass exterior, green field

state-farm-stadium.desc_short: State Farm Stadium: oval domed stadium clad in silver-white ribbed metal panels with vertical slots of dark glass, a long retractable roof panel in the center, low profile

neyland-stadium.desc_short: Neyland Stadium: huge closed college football bowl with orange and white checkered end zones, gray concrete stands, tall press box tower on one sideline, green field

target-field.desc_short: Target Field: downtown ballpark with dark green seats, tan limestone exterior, a canopy roof over the upper deck, a tall scoreboard in right field, grass field

rate-field.desc_short: Rate Field: symmetrical ballpark with dark navy seats in a closed ring of upper and lower decks, gray concrete exterior with arches, grass field and dirt infield

raymond-james-stadium.desc_short: Raymond James Stadium: football stadium with bright red seats, a large pirate ship in the north end zone stands, tall sideline press box, light concrete exterior, green field

chase-center.desc_short: Chase Center: round arena with a white rounded drum, a band of glass at the base, a flat white roof, a large glass atrium entrance at one side

comerica-park.desc_short: Comerica Park: downtown ballpark with dark green seats, brick facade with arches, open outfield toward the skyline, a large scoreboard in left field, grass field

spartan-stadium.desc_short: CEFCU Stadium San Jose: compact college football stadium with blue and gold accents, two tall sideline grandstands, open ends with low seating, green field
